name: Reload Agent Session Context
description: Explicitly invalidates one idle session's cached provider prefix so its next cached inference rebuilds the system prompt, fixed tools, skill catalog and pinned context from current agent configuration and sources. Conversation history and loaded context are preserved exactly. Changed declarative config already triggers this on the next inference; use this operation to force a same-config refresh. Uncached models retain no prefix, so this is a harmless no-op for them.

agentId.description: Agent reference: a bare name for the caller's agent, g/<id>, /g/<id>, or <ownerDID>/g/<id>

sessionId.description: Hex ID of the idle session whose provider prefix should be rebuilt, with or without a 0x prefix

reloaded.description: True when a materialised prefix was cleared
